verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit is a code-review SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack only shows CodeRabbit acting as an MCP client: it consumes external MCP servers as review context (docs-12), and the pricing page lists 'MCP connections' with no detail. Neither shows CodeRabbit exposing its own MCP server for agents to connect to. The Claude Code integration runs through the CLI, not MCP, so it does not count either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
